english_title: 44. For the Coming of the Month of Ramadan

phrases.english: Praise belongs to God who guided us to His praise

phrases.arabic: وَجَعَلَنَا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ، لِنَكُونَ لِإِحْسَانِهِ مِنَ الشَّاكِرِينَ
phrases.english: and placed us among the people of praise, that we might be among the thankful for His beneficence
and that He might recompense us for that with the recompense of the good-doers!
And praise belongs to God who showed favour to us through His religion,

phrases.arabic: وَاخْتَصَّنَا بِمِلَّتِهِ، وَسَبَّلَنَا فِي سُبُلِ إحْسَانِهِ،
phrases.english: singled us out for His creed, and directed us onto the roads of His beneficence,
in order that through His kindness we might travel upon them to His good pleasure,

phrases.arabic: حَمْدَاً يَتَقَبَّلُهُ مِنَّا، وَيَرْضَى بِهِ عَنَّا.
phrases.english: a praise which He will accept from us and through which He will be pleased with us!

phrases.arabic: وَالْحَمْدُ لِلّه الَّذِي جَعَلَ مِنْ تِلْكَ السُّبُلِ شَهْرَهُ شَهْرَ رَمَضَانَ،
phrases.english: And praise belongs to God who appointed among those roads His month, the month of Ramadan,

phrases.arabic: شَهْرَ الصِّيَامِ، وَشَهْرَ الإِسْلاَم، وَشَهْرَ الطَّهُورِ،
phrases.english: the month of fasting, the month of submission, the month of purity,
the month of putting to test, the month of standing in prayer,

phrases.arabic: الَّذِي أُنْزِلَ فِيْهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدىً لِلنَّاسِ،
phrases.english: "in which the Qur'an was sent down as guidance to the people,
and as clear signs of the Guidance and the Separator" (2:185)!
He clarified its excellence over other months

phrases.arabic: بِمَا جَعَلَ لَهُ مِنَ الْحُرُمَاتِ الْمَوْفُورَةِ وَالْفَضَائِلِ الْمَشْهُورَةِ،
phrases.english: by the many sacred things and well-known excellencies which He placed therein,

phrases.arabic: فَحَرَّمَ فِيْهِ ما أَحَلَّ فِي غَيْرِهِ إعْظَاماً،
phrases.english: for He made unlawful in it what He declared lawful in others to magnify it,
He prohibited foods and drinks in it to honour it,

phrases.arabic: وَجَعَلَ لَهُ وَقْتاً بَيِّناً لاَ يُجِيزُ جَلَّ وَعَزَّ أَنْ يُقَدَّمَ قَبْلَهُ،
phrases.english: and He appointed for it a clear time which He (majestic and mighty is He) allows not to be set forward
and accepts not to be placed behind.

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ فَضَّلَ لَيْلَةً وَاحِدَةً مِنْ لَيَالِيهِ عَلَى لَيَالِي أَلْفِ شَهْر،
phrases.english: Then He made one of its nights surpass the nights of a thousand months
and named it the Night of Decree;

phrases.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ الْمَلائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ  فِيهَا بِإذْنِ رَبِّهِمْ مِنْ كُلِّ أَمْر،
phrases.english: "in it the angels and the Spirit descend by the leave of their Lord upon every command,

phrases.arabic: سَلاَمٌ دَائِمُ الْبَرَكَةِ إلَى طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ،
phrases.english: a peace" (97:4-5) constant in blessings until the rising of the dawn

phrases.arabic: عَلَى مَنْ يَشَاءُ مِنْ  عِبَادِهِ بِمَا أَحْكَمَ مِنْ قَضَائِهِ.
phrases.english: upon whomsoever He will of His servants according to the decision He has made firm.
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
inspire us with knowledge of its excellence, veneration of its inviolability,
and caution against what You hast forbidden within it,

phrases.arabic: وَأَعِنَّـا عَلَى صِيَامِـهِ بِكَفِّ الْجَـوَارِحِ عَنْ مَعَاصِيْكَ،
phrases.english: and help us to fast in it by our restraining our limbs from acts of disobedience toward You
and our employing them in that which pleases You,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لاَ نُصْغِىَ بِأَسْمَاعِنَا إلَى لَغْو،
phrases.english: so that we lend not our ears to idle talk
and hurry not with our eyes to diversion,

phrases.arabic: وَحَتَّى لاَ نَبْسُطَ أَيْدِيَنَا إلَى مَحْظُور،
phrases.english: we stretch not our hands toward the forbidden
and stride not with our feet toward the prohibited,

phrases.arabic: وَحَتَّى لاَ تَعِيَ بُطُونُنَا إلاَّ مَا أَحْلَلْتَ،
phrases.english: our bellies hold only what You hast made lawful

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَنْطِقَ أَلْسِنَتُنَا إلاَّ بِمَا مَثَّلْتَ
phrases.english: and our tongues speak only what You hast exemplified,

phrases.arabic: وَلا نَتَكَلَّفَ إلاَّ ما يُدْنِي مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ،
phrases.english: we undertake nothing but what brings close to Your reward

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ نَتَعَاطَى إلاّ الَّذِي يَقِيْ مِنْ عِقَابِكَ،
phrases.english: and pursue nothing but what protects from Your punishment!

phrases.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلِّصْ ذَلِكَ كُلَّهُ مِنْ رِئآءِ الْمُرَائِينَ وَسُمْعَةِ الْمُسْمِعِينَ،
phrases.english: Then rid all of that from the false show of the false showers and the fame seeking of the fame seekers,
lest we associate therein anything with You
or seek therein any object of desire but You!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
in it make us attend to the appointed moments
of the five prayers within the bounds You hast set,

phrases.arabic: وَفُرُوضِهَا  الَّتِي فَرَضْتَ وَوَظَائِفِهَا الَّتِي وَظَّفْتَ،
phrases.english: the obligations You hast decreed, the duties You hast assigned,
and the times You hast specified;
and in the prayers make us alight in the station of the keepers of their stations,
the guardians of their pillars, their performers in their times,

phrases.arabic: فِي أَوْقَاتِهَـا عَلَى مَا سَنَّـهُ عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُـولُكَ صَلَوَاتُـكَ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِـهِ
phrases.english: as Your servant and Your messenger set down in his Sunna (Your blessings be upon him and his Household)
in their bowings, their prostrations, and all their excellent acts,

phrases.arabic: عَلى أَتَمِّ الطَّهُورِ، وَأَسْبَغِهِ وَأَبْيَنِ الْخُشُوعِ وَأَبْلَغِهِ،
phrases.english: with the most complete and ample ritual purity and the most evident and intense humility!

phrases.arabic: وَوَفِّقْنَا فِيهِ لاِنْ نَصِلَ أَرْحَامَنَا بِالبِرِّ وَالصِّلَةِ
phrases.english: Give us success in this month to tighten our bonds of kin with devotion and gifts,
attend to our neighbours with bestowal and giving,
rid our possessions from claims,
purify them through paying the alms,
go back to him who has gone far from us,
treat justly him who has wronged us,
make peace with him who shows enmity toward us
(except him who is regarded as an enemy in You and for You,
for he is the enemy whom we will not befriend,
the party whom we will not hold dear),

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْ نَتَقَرَّبَ إلَيْكَ فِيْهِ مِنَ الأَعْمَالِ الزَّاكِيَةِ بِمَا تُطَهِّرُنا بِهِ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ،
phrases.english: and seek nearness to You through blameless works which will purify us from sins

phrases.arabic: وَتَعْصِمُنَا فِيهِ مِمَّا نَسْتَأنِفُ مِنَ الْعُيُوبِ،
phrases.english: and preserve us from renewing faults,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لا يُورِدَ عَلَيْكَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ مَلاَئِكَتِكَ
phrases.english: so that none of Your angels will bring for You

phrases.arabic: إلاّ دُونَ مَا نُورِدُ مِنْ أَبْوابِ الطَّاعَةِ لَكَ، وَأَنْوَاعِ القُرْبَةِ إلَيْكَ.
phrases.english: the kinds of obedience and sorts of nearness-seeking unless they be less than what we bring!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هَذَا الشَّهْرِ،
phrases.english: O God, I ask You by the right of this month
and by the right of him who worships You within it
from its beginning to the time of its passing,

phrases.arabic: مِنْ مَلَك قَرَّبْتَهُ أَوْ نَبِيٍّ أَرْسَلْتَهُ
phrases.english: whether angel You hast brought nigh to You, prophet You hast sent,
or righteous servant You hast singled out,
that You bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَأَهِّلْنَا فِيهِ لِمَا وَعَدْتَ أَوْلِياءَكَ مِنْ كَرَامَتِكَ،
phrases.english: make us worthy of the generosity You hast promised Your friends,

phrases.arabic: وَأَوْجِبْ لَنَا فِيهِ مَا أَوْجَبْتَ لأِهْلِ الْمُبَالَغَةِ فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
phrases.english: make incumbent for us what You hast made incumbent for those who go to great lengths in obeying You,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي نَظْمِ مَنِ اسْتَحَقَّ الرَّفِيْعَ الأعْلَى بِرَحْمَتِكَ.
phrases.english: and place us in the ranks of those who deserve through Your mercy the highest elevation!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَجَنِّبْنَا الإلْحَادَ فِي تَوْحِيدِكَ وَالتَّقْصِيرَ فِي تَمْجِيدِكَ
phrases.english: turn us aside from deviation in professing Your Unity, falling short in magnifying You,

phrases.arabic: وَالشَّكَّ فِي دِينِـكَ وَالْعَمَى عَنْ سَبِيْلِكَ وَالاغْفَالَ لِحُرْمَتِكَ،
phrases.english: uncertainty in Your religion, blindness toward Your path, heedlessness of Your inviolability,
and being deceived by Your enemy, the accursed Satan!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَإذَا كَانَ لَكَ فِيْ كُلِّ لَيْلَة مِنْ لَيَالِيْ شَهْرِنَا هَذَا
phrases.english: and when in every night of this month's nights

phrases.arabic: رِقَابٌ يُعْتِقُهَا عَفْوُكَ أَوْ يَهَبُهَا صَفْحُكَ
phrases.english: You hast necks which Your pardon will release and Your forgiveness disregard,
place our necks among those necks

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْنَا لِشَهْرِنَا مِنْ خَيْرِ أَهْل وَأَصْحَاب.
phrases.english: and place us among the best folk and companions of this our month!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,
efface our sins along with the effacing of its crescent moon,

phrases.arabic: وَاسْلَخْ عَنَّا تَبِعَاتِنَا مَعَ انْسِلاَخِ أَيَّامِهِ
phrases.english: and make us pass forth from the ill effects of our acts with the passing of its days,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى يَنْقَضِي  عَنَّا وَقَدْ صَفَّيْتَنَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْخَطِيئاتِ
phrases.english: until it leaves us behind, while within it You hast purified us of offenses
and rid us of evil deeds!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ مِلْنَا فِيهِ فَعَدِّلْنا، وَإنْ زِغْنَا فِيهِ فَقَوِّمْنَا
phrases.english: and should we go off to one side in this month, set us aright; should we swerve, point us straight;

phrases.arabic: وَإنِ اشْتَمَلَ عَلَيْنَا عَدُوُّكَ الشَّيْطَانُ فَاسْتَنْقِذْنَا مِنْهُ
phrases.english: and should Your enemy Satan enwrap us, rescue us from him!
O God, fill this month with our worship of You,
adorn its times with our obedience toward You,
help us during its daytime with its fast,
and in its night with prayer
and pleading toward You, humility toward You,
and lowliness before You,

phrases.arabic: حَتَّى لا يَشْهَدَ نَهَارُهُ عَلَيْنَا بِغَفْلَة، وَلا لَيْلُهُ بِتَفْرِيط.
phrases.english: so that its daytime may not bear witness against our heedlessness, nor its night against our neglect!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ وَاجْعَلْنَا فِي سَائِرِ الشُّهُورِ وَالأَيَّامِ كَذَلِكَ مَا عَمَّرْتَنَا،
phrases.english: O God, make us like this in the other months and days as long as You givest us life,
and place us among Your righteous servants,

phrases.arabic: الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ الْفِرْدَوْسَ، هُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ،
phrases.english: "those who shall inherit Paradise, therein dwelling forever" (23:11),
"those who give what they give, while their hearts quake,
that they are returning to their Lord" (23:60),

phrases.arabic: وَمِنَ الَّذِينَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي الْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ.
phrases.english: those who "..vie in good works, outracing to them" (23:61)!
O God, bless Muhammad and his Household

phrases.arabic: فِي كُلِّ وَقْت وَكُلِّ أَوَان وَعَلَى  كُـلِّ حَال
phrases.english: in every time, in all moments, and in every state,

phrases.arabic: عَـدَدَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَى مَنْ صَلَّيْتَ عَلَيْهِ،
phrases.english: to the number that You hast blessed whomsoever You hast blessed
and to multiples of all that, through multiples
which none can count but You!
Surely You art Accomplisher of what You desirest.
